edits.reason: Root source clarification verified: apologizing for causing discomfort, not apology itself causing discomfort. Spanish already correct; unchanged verification. EN root-owned.

edits.after: Sometimes cold text loses some of the warmth of speech, along with the chance to correct a misunderstanding as it happens.
edits.reason: Naturalizes small warmth and immediate corrections without denying the preceding benefits of writing.
edits.before: Sometimes the small warmth and immediate corrections possible in speech are instead lost in cold text.

edits.after: Fourth, a question must not turn the relationship into a bargaining chip.
edits.reason: Idiomatic rendering of putting the relationship at stake to force an answer, as49–52 specify.
edits.before: Fourth, the question must not put the relationship up as a stake.

edits.after: Giving up the attempt to remake the other person gives both people another chance to relate as whole persons.
edits.reason: Source does not assert both people were trying to remake each other; removes added mutuality while preserving benefit to both.
edits.before: Giving up the attempt to remake each other lets both people have another chance to relate as whole persons.

edits.after: Dejar de intentar transformar al otro da a ambos otra oportunidad de relacionarse como personas completas.
edits.reason: Removes added transformarse mutuamente; example has one person doing the repeated persuading, benefits both.
edits.before: Dejar de transformarse mutuamente da a ambos otra oportunidad de relacionarse como personas completas.

edits.after: “I'm keeping quiet now so that, in the end, you'll take my advice.”
edits.reason: Makes strategic silence's continuing persuasive aim explicit; avoids ambiguous scope of not trying so that.
edits.before: “I'm not trying to persuade you so that, eventually, you'll listen to me.”

edits.after: «Dejo de insistir ahora para que al final acabes haciéndome caso».
edits.reason: Clarifies quoted strategy still aims at eventual compliance; No insisto para que could read as denying that aim.
edits.before: «No insisto para que acabes haciéndome caso».
